name: invalid keys receive no attention
test:
import torch
torch.manual_seed(10)
encoder = MaskedEncoder(8, 2).eval()
x = torch.randn(1, 4, 8)
mask = torch.tensor([[True, True, False, False]])
encoded, weights = encoder(x, mask)
assert encoded.shape == x.shape and weights.shape == (1, 2, 4, 4)
assert torch.isfinite(encoded).all()
assert torch.equal(weights[..., 2:], torch.zeros_like(weights[..., 2:]))

name: padding values cannot affect valid outputs
test:
import torch
torch.manual_seed(11)
encoder = MaskedEncoder(8, 2).eval()
x = torch.randn(1, 4, 8); changed = x.clone(); changed[:, 2:] = 1000
mask = torch.tensor([[True, True, False, False]])
a, _ = encoder(x, mask); b, _ = encoder(changed, mask)
assert torch.allclose(a[:, :2], b[:, :2], atol=1e-5)

name: classifier pools only valid states
test:
import torch
torch.manual_seed(12)
encoder = MaskedEncoder(8, 2).eval()
mean_head = MaskedEncoderClassifier(encoder, 4, pooling='mean').eval()
max_head = MaskedEncoderClassifier(encoder, 4, pooling='max').eval()
x = torch.randn(2, 3, 8); mask = torch.tensor([[True, True, False], [True, True, True]])
assert mean_head(x, mask).shape == (2, 4)
assert max_head(x, mask).shape == (2, 4)
